title: desmodium trigonum
intro: Desmodium trigonum, commonly known as Crofton weed or Stick-tight, is a perennial herb native to Australia and New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Desmodium trigonum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
